name: VRV & VRF units
tagline: One outdoor system, many independently controlled zones
description: Variable refrigerant flow systems built for multi-zone efficiency, comfort control, and flexible building layouts.
long_description: VRV/VRF systems connect one outdoor unit, or a bank of them, to many indoor units of different styles: wall, cassette, ductable and more. Each zone sets its own temperature, and the system varies refrigerant flow to match real demand, so it uses far less energy than running many separate ACs. Central controllers make it easy to manage a whole building.
features: Independent temperature control for every zone
Mix and match indoor unit types on one system
High part-load efficiency through variable refrigerant flow
Centralised control and scheduling for facility teams

specs.label: Indoor units per system
specs.value: Up to around 64, depending on brand and model

specs.label: Controls
specs.value: Individual remotes, central controller, BMS integration

variants.suits: Sites that need cooling and heating at the same time

considerations: Plan the outdoor unit location and piping routes during design
Pair with a treated fresh-air unit for good indoor air quality
Copper piping and brazing quality are critical; we nitrogen-purge every joint

faqs.question: What's the difference between VRV and VRF?
faqs.answer: VRV is Daikin's brand name for the technology. VRF is the general term used by other manufacturers. They work the same way.

faqs.question: Can VRF be added floor by floor?
faqs.answer: Yes. Modular outdoor units let you phase installation and extend the system as floors are fitted out.
